coverage: WF7I1248BBR purchased directly from Currys only; not the full campaign

capture.format: Safari print-to-PDF of the official terms page

sections_reviewed: §3.6 proof of purchase and serial number
Annex 1, including Currys and Soloco group members
verified_facts: Annex 1 lists Currys as a participating retailer; purchases must be directly from the named retailer rather than a third-party marketplace seller.
Annex 2 lists Hisense WF7I1248BBR for GBP 100 cashback.
Purchase dates are 9 September through 27 October 2026 inclusive.
Claims may be submitted 27 November through 24 December 2026 inclusive.
A valid proof of purchase and product serial number are required.
A claimant may claim for different eligible models and is limited to five claims per household.
exclusions_and_limitations: Claimant must be a UK resident aged 18 or over and purchase as a consumer.
Employees and other persons listed in §4.2 are excluded.
Graded, ex-display, seconds, imperfect and replacement products are excluded.
Cancelled or returned purchases are excluded.
Third-party marketplace purchases are excluded; the direct retailer must match Annex 1.
The offer cannot be combined with specified promoter or group offers running during the same period.
The promoter may require eligibility and identity evidence.
The receipt must show retailer, model, purchase date and purchase price; the claim must include proof of purchase and product serial number.
evidence.claim_portal_observation: The official terms provide this claim destination (§§5.1 and 5.12). The portal was not independently accessed; availability and claim acceptance have not been verified.

supporting_source.comparison: The locally available supporting terms copy corroborates the target model, amount and dates. The primary 19 August terms are authoritative where the copies differ.
supporting_source.retrieval_note: The exact retrieval time of the local copy was not established; no timestamp is asserted.

evidence.excluded_cross_campaign_evidence: The separate May–June 2026 A-Rated Appliances promotion is not evidence for this Autumn offer.

requirements.description: Submit valid proof of purchase showing retailer, product model, purchase date and purchase price (§§3.6, 5.2, 5.3 and 5.5).
Provide the product serial number with the claim (§§3.6, 5.2 and 5.5).

limitations: This reference covers only model WF7I1248BBR purchased directly from Currys; other models and retailers are not assessed.

Eligibility also depends on the terms' claimant, residence, age, consumer-use, product-condition, seller, return, offer-combination and household-limit rules. Those facts are not inputs to the current eligibility request and are not evaluated here.

The eligibility result is based on recorded promotion rules and does not guarantee claim acceptance or payment; Hisense validates claimant details, receipt, serial number and other evidence during the claim process.
